author: @FrankCurzio
text:
AI just took charge of online shopping.

OpenAI just launched ChatGPT Wallet. Its AI agents can now buy things for you on your own Amex, Mastercard or Visa card, and you keep your rewards.

OpenAI has 1.2B weekly users but makes most of its money from subscriptions. The real money online is the moment someone buys... and Google made a fortune selling ads right there.

So now OpenAI wants that moment. It's taking NO cut on purchases to start. That's how you hook merchants before you put up a toll.

Yet every purchase still runs on a one-time token the card network issues. The agent never even sees your card.

Same picks-and-shovels setup as the AI buildout. Don't bet on which agent wins. $V & $MA sit on the road every agent has to drive on.

Once OpenAI does start charging, retailers eat that fee, because an agent shopping on price won't accept a markup.

-

For anyone new here, I'm Frank. 30 years on Wall Street, and I post what's moving the market as it happens. Follow me @FrankCurzio for more.
